FLAC codec: decoder plus encoder.

Decoder ports symphonia-bundle-flac (decoder.rs): constant, verbatim, fixed (orders 0-4) and LPC (orders 1-32) subframes, Rice/Rice2 partitions with escape, wasted bits, mid/side + left/right-side decorrelation, MSB-aligned S32 output, MD5 validation. Wrapping arithmetic matches the reference release behavior bit-for-bit and never raises on hostile input.

The encoder is new work (subset: fixed predictors + verbatim, Rice order-0 partitions, independent channels, optional wasted bits).

Parsed STREAMINFO block (34 bytes). Lives here (rather than with the demuxer) so the decoder can parse extra_data, mirroring how Symphonia shares it via symphonia-common.
